messages.author: f71b427e7495bd64
messages.subject: RRO and devtool::revdep_check
parts:
When testing reverse dependencies before the release of magrittr v1.5 (https://github.com/smbache/magrittr/releases) I experienced that devtools::revdep_check failed with RRO and not with regular R.

My setup is Windows 7, RRO 8.0 beta, and Rstudio Version 0.98.1091. 

I did not dig too much into the details, as it worked with standard R, but perhaps it is due to the mran mirror thing?
